title: WaterColor "Low Key Cottage" 785 Western Lake Drive
h1: WaterColor "Low Key Cottage" 785 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 11 wristbands.- Located in the Park District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Wrap around 2nd floor porch- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- 4 adult bikes- Propane grill- 1 parking spot- 6 Passenger GEM Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Discover the laid-back serenity of Low Key Cottage—a stunning 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom haven that sleeps 11 guests. Designed for comfort, this coastal escape boasts a second-floor wraparound deck, lovely living space, and plenty of outdoor spots to unwind with family. Minutes from the beach, it provides easy access to WaterColor’s incredible amenities, including community pools, nature trails, and the Beach Club—perfect for relaxation and adventure!Shaded by sand live oaks, the lovely front porch with a bench swing and rocking chairs warmly welcomes guests to this stunning 2-story property. Inside, the bright and airy great room, with a plush sectional and cozy armchair, is perfect for relaxing, sharing stories, or enjoying a family movie night. The chef of the group will love being creative in the pristine white kitchen, complete with sleek cabinetry, elegant countertops, and high-end gourmet appliances accented in gold. A spacious island with seating for 4 invites casual mornings over coffee or late-night cocktails, conveniently located next to “Sandy’s Beach Club” wet bar and beverage cooler. Share meals around the family dining table, beautifully lit by a coastal chandelier and featuring a mix of bench and chair seating. Step outside onto the enclosed deck to relax in plush seating while soaking in serene backyard views. At the end of the day, retire to the first-floor guest bedroom with a lavish king bed, desk, and private bathroom. A charming baby-blue laundry room with a stacked washer and dryer is ideal for extended stays. Rounding out this floor is the coffee bar and half bath.Luxurious accommodations await on the second floor, featuring a wraparound balcony with treetop views, as well as an elegant primary bedroom with a king bed, balcony access, and a spacious private bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub. Down the hall are 2 additional bedrooms—1 guest room with a king bed and private bathroom, and 1 bunk room with twin-over-twin and twin-over-full beds, a TV, and private bathroom.Low Key Cottage is the perfect family getaway with on-site parking, 4 complimentary bikes, and a low-speed vehicle for easy exploration. Discover Western Lake, Seaside's shops and restaurants, nearby Publix, and Scenic 30A. For beach access, enjoy the Watercolor Beach Club—only 4 minutes by bike or 6 minutes by car! Book now!* There are 2 parking spaces for this home, one of which is taken up by the on-site golf cart leaving space for only 1 vehicle to park in the driveway.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 11):FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed and Twin over Full Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
